text: No tree-cover loss events of 0.5 hectares or larger have been detected on this 2,843.1-hectare rural property since 2021. The most recent supported loss events were in 2020 (67.7 ha), 2017 (4.8 ha), 2015 (25.5 ha), and 2008 (0.8 ha). While small changes under 0.5 ha or within 30-meter pixel limitations might not be captured, no significant losses occurred between 2021 and 2025 according to the Hansen GFC and JRC GFC2020 datasets. The property had negligible forest cover in 2020 (0 ha) and minimal tree cover in 2000 (23 ha), with only minor patch losses (0.4 ha) in 2021.
